name: TensorFold + B70 tree-attention row-split patch
summary: TensorFold v1.2.4 Level Zero build with a two-change decode-attention patch: tree rows of a key slice dispatched back to back (L2 reuse) and per-row slice width (32/128/256 keys). +28% decode at 32K, +48% at 131K; drafted output stays identical to serial.
notes: Patch SHA-256 308a9a7c15a4fc4a7603648154f382aa4f9188d6c087b5a8ec40ce1015777664, applies to TensorFold v1.2.4 (kernels/xpu/qwen27/decode.cl and src/xpu/forward.zig). Built with Zig 0.17.0 and ocloc 26.05 plus a one-line local change that drops a 128-GRF build flag for Gemma 4 kernels (ocloc 26.05 rejects it). Offered upstream to ashhart/TensorFold.
